changes: Taxa are keyed by the IPNI identifier of the accepted name in the World Checklist of Vascular Plants; printed names are kept and linked.
Each annotation class is defined once, in a shared graph, instead of in the graph of every flora that uses it.

Absence of a part is written as not (has part some (part of some X)), after Gkoutos et al. 2018; every record names its evidence (ECO:0007319, author statement used in automatic assertion); data licensed CC BY 4.0; dataset description (VoID, DCAT, schema.org, CSVW) published.

Every phenotype class is a phene, a quality of the plant: 'flora phenotype' and 'phenotype of' some (defining property), after Hoehndorf et al. 2010 and Gkoutos et al. 2018; taxa are linked with 'has phenotype' (RO:0002200), the inverse of the functional 'phenotype of' (RO:0002201); FLOPO 2026-11-22.

After a review by Marco Schmidt: descriptions that an aggregator republishes are kept once; the position of a part named by the flora (basal leaves, lateral umbels) is recorded and written with the relation has position (FLOPO:0995004), FLOPO 2026-11-23; grass spikelet parts (awn, palea, lodicule) used in other families are set to review and have their own section; traits can be searched by label or synonym; the Kew FTEA source is named as such; the records can be read as plain RDF without OWL: a taxon points to its records (fb:record) and plain-records.nt.gz has them as N-Triples.
